candidates.currentAiSurface: Generated senti.flow skill carries operational branching, approval rules, retry rules, worktree rules, and per-step instructions in a large runtime prompt.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Move normal step branching, context descriptors, output schema, retry metadata, and post-hook instructions into `senti flow get next-action` envelope fields.
candidates.expectedEffect: Smaller skill prompt and fewer model-side routing decisions before each flow step.
candidates.qualityRisk: Moving destructive recovery and user approval exceptions out of the skill could hide irreversible decisions.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Keep approval boundaries, autoApprove exceptions, worktree boundary, and destructive recovery prompts in the skill until equivalent envelope safeguards are proven.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Compare next-action envelopes with generated skill responsibilities and verify approval-gated choices still surface before execution.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Spec review receives rendered spec context and asks AI to classify blocking completeness issues.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Generate a review manifest with changed spec fields, requirement/task coverage, migration parity inventory, and acceptance/testability fields before invoking AI.
candidates.expectedEffect: Reduced spec-review input size and fewer repeated completeness checks already expressible as schema or manifest facts.
candidates.qualityRisk: A manifest that omits a spec contradiction can suppress a real blocking finding.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Run full spec review whenever manifest generation fails, required sections are missing, migration parity is incomplete, or manifest confidence is boundary/unknown.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Replay representative spec-review artifacts and confirm existing blocking findings are either represented in the manifest or routed to full AI review.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Implementation review can send broad diffs, requirement maps, previous review memory, and task spec content to AI.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Create per-file/requirement review manifests with changed hunks, public surface flags, file-map coverage, test evidence summary, risky pattern scan results, and previous finding resolution state.
candidates.expectedEffect: Lower input tokens for impl-review and fewer loop review chunks when manifest evidence is sufficient.
candidates.qualityRisk: Compressed hunks may hide cross-file behavior contradictions or security/data-integrity issues.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Use full impl-review when public API/schema/config changes are detected, file-map is incomplete, risky pattern scan is inconclusive, or changed hunks exceed manifest limits.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Compare impl-review findings before/after on specs 293-299 and require no loss of blocking failure modes.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Test review inspects test code and requirement coverage for anti-patterns and missing coverage.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Generate a requirement-level coverage matrix with test file, test name, assertion or executable block count, skip/helper markers, and scenario/test-execute references.
candidates.expectedEffect: Smaller static review input and deterministic detection of empty coverage, skipped tests, helper-only tests, and missing R-N names.
candidates.qualityRisk: Assertion counting cannot prove assertion semantic quality.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Run full test review when matrix parsing fails, executable blocks cannot be identified, assertion intent is ambiguous, or anti-pattern scans find boundary cases.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Verify matrix rows cover every testable requirement and test-review still detects input-as-expected and existence-only anti-patterns.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Integration gate evaluates whether implementation satisfies requirements using diff, file-map, and test evidence.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Precheck missing file-map entries, no-diff requirements, missing test evidence, unregistered changed files, and requirement-to-file coverage before AI judgment.
candidates.expectedEffect: Obvious pass/fail cases are handled before AI, leaving only undecidable semantic compliance to model judgment.
candidates.qualityRisk: Static pass conditions may over-trust file-map and test presence without verifying behavior.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Send undecidable requirements to AI whenever file-map/test evidence exists but behavior equivalence cannot be determined from diff and test summaries.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Ensure pre-AI obvious failures match existing gate failures and undecidable requirements retain AI review.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Context search may use AI keyword selection to recover relevant files.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Prefer deterministic keyword/path search and only ask AI for keyword selection when zero useful results are found and fallback is explicitly allowed.
candidates.expectedEffect: Avoids AI calls for searches that already produce relevant code/doc context.
candidates.qualityRisk: Deterministic search can miss semantic aliases when the request wording differs from code terminology.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Use AI keyword selection only when deterministic search is insufficient and explicit AI fallback allowance is present.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Run queries with known hits and zero-hit cases; verify AI is skipped for deterministic hits and used for allowed boundary cases.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Auto-check uses static gates plus AI scoring for buildability, ambiguity, verifiability, scope boundedness, target specificity, and precedent.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Rule-score explicit Goal/Scope/Expected/Out of scope/Reproduction/target path/verification phrase fields and send only boundary cases to AI.
candidates.expectedEffect: Obvious eligible or ineligible requests avoid AI scoring.
candidates.qualityRisk: Rule scoring may misclassify nuanced research or multi-surface requests.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Use AI scoring when static gate data is incomplete, rule scores are near threshold, or any hard-gate category is ambiguous.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Compare static verdicts against current auto-check outcomes and require boundary cases to preserve existing AI scoring.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Finalize-sync runs docs build on the blocking finalize path, and docs build can invoke AI-capable docs steps.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Separate deterministic docs scan/init/data from AI enrich/text/readme/agents/translate, and make AI docs steps conditional or follow-up artifacts when quality gate is already complete.
candidates.expectedEffect: Reduced finalize wait time for code changes that do not need AI docs regeneration.
candidates.qualityRisk: Docs drift can persist if AI docs steps are deferred incorrectly.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Run full docs build when public docs surfaces changed, docs quality verification fails, generated directives are stale, or release policy requires synced natural language docs.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Compare docs output and finalize-sync timing before/after, and require warnings/follow-up artifacts for deferred AI docs steps.

candidates.currentAiSurface: docs.enrich, docs.text, README, AGENTS, and translate can ask AI to classify or regenerate natural language content.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Infer keywords, chapter, and role from path/export/import/command names; render README command lists and AGENTS project sections from data where possible.
candidates.expectedEffect: Less AI text generation for stable structural content.
candidates.qualityRisk: Natural-language summaries may become too mechanical or miss intent.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Use AI when structural data is incomplete, source hashes changed in prose-heavy files, or generated text quality checks fail.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Check generated docs for unresolved directives, chapter placement, and README/AGENTS content parity.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Some review paths may retry or repair malformed AI JSON output.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Use schema-aware normalizer for markdown fences, surrounding prose, defaults, extra keys, enum normalization, and parser-repairable JSON.
candidates.expectedEffect: Fewer second AI calls for output repair and clearer hard-fail boundaries.
candidates.qualityRisk: Normalizer can fabricate missing semantic fields if defaults are too aggressive.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Hard fail or use AI repair only when required semantic fields cannot be derived without changing meaning.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Fixture malformed JSON cases and ensure normalizer preserves original response plus normalized output.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Repeated review/gate findings may be passed onward separately for issue-log, flow-findings, and acceptance review.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Group findings using sourceStep/sourceArtifact/sourceFindingId or sourceStep/file/locator/requirementRef/failureMode keys with severity merge rules.
candidates.expectedEffect: Reduced duplicate finding volume before acceptance review and clearer audit history.
candidates.qualityRisk: Aggressive grouping can hide distinct failures sharing the same file or requirement.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Keep findings separate when keys are incomplete, severity conflicts cannot be merged, or evidence references differ materially.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Verify grouped findings retain original members, highest severity, evidence refs, and latest disposition.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Triage and repair artifacts may be manually or semantically derived from review findings.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Generate initial triage values and repair checklist templates from guardrail_id, where.file, locator, requirementRef, and failureMode.
candidates.expectedEffect: Less repeated reasoning for mechanical triage and clearer mutation audit templates.
candidates.qualityRisk: Mechanical templates cannot decide semantic correctness of a fix.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Require human/AI semantic repair when disposition changes behavior, rejects a finding, or modifies requirements.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Confirm generated templates preserve finding identity and require explicit semantic rationale for applied repairs.

candidates.currentAiSurface: Integration gate asks AI whether requirements are implemented in the diff.
candidates.deterministicCandidate: Pre-summarize requirements with file-map entries, changed files, test evidence, and no-diff/missing-evidence obvious failures.
candidates.expectedEffect: Smaller AI input for requirements that have complete file/test evidence and early rejection of obvious misses.
candidates.qualityRisk: Presence of changed files and tests does not prove behavior implementation.
candidates.fallbackCondition: Send requirement to AI when behavior cannot be decided from diff, file-map, and test summaries alone.
candidates.behaviorVerification: Compare precheck decisions with gate observations and require AI review for all undecidable requirements.
